name: Dal er Bora
steps: Rinse masoor dal and soak in measured water until the grains soften; drain exceptionally well.
Coarsely pulse the dal with ginger and chili so some lentil fragments remain visible; avoid adding water.
Fold in chopped onion, nigella, coriander, rice flour and salt; beat briefly by hand to bind the mixture.
Drop small irregular spoonfuls into medium-hot oil and fry in batches without crowding, turning after the bottoms set.
Fry to deep golden and crisp, drain on a rack and serve hot with kasundi or coriander chutney.
tips: The nigella seeds supply the distinct Bengali aroma; keep the lentil paste coarse for texture.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
